title: One command sets Lockstep up in a new repository
lockstep_bin: uvx, installed fresh from the source (no machine cache)

rows.label: .claude/settings.json has a PreToolUse entry calling lockstep-hook
lefthook.yml has a lockstep command
rows.command: for c in "" trace sources docmeta; do [ -z "$c" ] && ! git rev-parse -q --verify HEAD >/dev/null && continue; uvx --from git+https://github.com/BrianMills2718/agentic-engineering-system-canonical lockstep check $c || exit 1; done

rows.label: the hook commands install from the AES canonical address, not the lockstep repository
no second tool (pcw, code2check) is installed by any written file

  commands:
    lockstep:
      run: for c in "" trace sources docmeta; do [ -z "$c" ] && ! git rev-parse -q --verify HEAD >/dev/null && continue; uvx --from git+https://github.com/BrianMills2718/agentic-engineering-system-canonical lockstep check $c || exit 1; done
files_written.lockstep.yaml:
# Lockstep's settings (docs: README.md, "Install Lockstep in a repository").
schema: lockstep.side.v1

# Each commit check (`lockstep check <name>`) is block (fail the commit), warn (print and pass) or off (skip).
checks:
  trace: block
  arch: block
  test-first: block
  sources: block
  docmeta: block
  project: block

# The GitHub owner of this repository's organization or account.
owner: example-org

sources:
  # A `Source:` line starting with this regex counts as a human's word; `Source: inferred by agent (...)` never does.
  human_pattern: "human"

# Folders where every file must be planned (for example [src/]). Empty means the edit guard checks no folder.
governed: []

# The plan's files: path, purpose, implements (OpenSpec requirement IDs), tests. `lockstep layout` creates them.
layout: []

lefthook: for c in "" trace sources docmeta; do [ -z "$c" ] && ! git rev-parse -q --verify HEAD >/dev/null && continue; uvx --from git+https://github.com/BrianMills2718/agentic-engineering-system-canonical lockstep check $c || exit 1; done
